blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Short-video platforms rank new uploads before anyone has watched them, using content towers that read a video's cover, title and frames. Existing attacks on content-aware recommenders perturb pixels or features and ignore platform re-encoding, and existing defenses train against norm-bounded perturbations that neither match real edits nor preserve recommendation quality. We show with REAP, a realizable attack through {a simulated platform channel (H.264 transcoding, rescaling, cropping and JPEG)}, that packaging edits raise a cold video by 32.0 rank-percentile points in unrelated audiences. We then observe that cold-start ranking does not need the packaging at all: a tower that sees only the video body ranks cold items best. Building on this, we propose Evidence-First Ranking (EFR), which scores cold videos from their body, admits packaging only through a support-gated residual bounded by $γ$, and merges cold and warm rankings by rank percentile, yielding an exact certificate against any packaging edit. On MicroLens-100K, EFR cuts the attack gain by 81% and raises cold-start Recall@100 from 0.1133 to 0.170, while keeping the merged NDCG@10 within 4% of the undefended system.
blocks.zh: 短视频平台在任何人观看之前对新的上传进行排名,使用内容塔阅读视频封面,标题和帧. 现有攻击内容-知觉推荐者扰动像素或特性,忽略了平台重编码,现有防御列车对抗规范约束的扰动,既不匹配真实编辑,也不维护推荐质量. 我们通过 {模拟平台频道(H.264 转码、缩放、裁剪和 JPEG )> 显示, 包装编辑器在不相关的受众中以32.0 级-百分点提升一个冷视频。 然后,我们观察到冷启动排名根本不需要包装:一个只看到视频机身的塔楼将冷却物品排在最佳位置. 在此基础上,我们提出“证据-第一排名”(EFR),该排名从他们身体中评分冷酷视频,只通过以美元为界的辅助残留来接受包装,并以百分位合并冷热排名,得出准确的证明,以抵制任何包装编辑。 在MicroLens-100K上,EFR将攻击增益减少81%,并将冷启动Recall@100从0.113提高到0.170,同时将合并的NDCG@10保持在无防守系统的4%之内.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Short-video platforms must rank millions of new uploads before anyone has watched them. For these cold videos no interactions exist, so recommenders score them with content towers built on vision-language encoders that read the cover, the title and the frames [ 21 ] . The cover and the title are also the cheapest parts of a video to change: a caption burned into the cover or a few extra hashtags cost nothing and leave the video untouched.
blocks.zh: 短视频平台在任何人观看前,必须排出上传的上传量上百万个. 对于这些冷酷的视频,不存在互动,因此建议者以内容塔来评分,这些内容塔建立在视觉语言编码器上,可以读取封面,标题和帧 [21]. 封面和标题也是视频中最廉价的可更改部分:一个被烧成封面的字幕或几个额外的标签一文不值一文,让视频保持未受侵犯.

blocks.en: Recommenders that read item images or text are known to be steerable [ 18 , 3 , 23 ] , but the risk is usually considered contained. Platforms re-encode every upload, which destroys crafted pixel perturbations [ 28 ] , and adversarial training against norm-bounded feature perturbations [ 30 , 33 ] is meant to absorb what survives. We highlight that this view rests on untested premises: attacks are rarely measured after a real codec [ 8 ] , their gains are not separated into targeted and generic parts, and defenses are tuned to convenient budgets rather than to the size of real edits. We therefore ask three questions: RQ1: How much exposure can realizable packaging buy after the platform channel? RQ2: Can robust training remove it without hurting recommendation? RQ3: How can a platform rank cold videos so that edits to the packaging cannot buy exposure?
blocks.zh: 阅读项目图像或文本的推荐者已知可被制导 [18, 3, 23],但通常认为风险已经控制. 平台每上传一次重编码,破坏所制作的像素扰动[28],对抗受规范约束的特征扰动的对抗训练[30,33],意在吸收所活下来的东西. 我们强调,这种观点基于未经测试的前提:攻击很少在真实的代码 [8] 之后加以衡量,其收益没有被分割成目标部分和通用部分,防御被调整为方便的预算而不是真实编辑的规模. 因此,我们提出三个问题: RQ1: 请检查url=值 (帮助). 平台通道后可实现的包装能购买多少?. RQ2:稳健的训练能否在无损推荐的情况下删除?. RQ3:平台如何排出冷酷视频,让编辑到包装上无法购买曝光?.

blocks.en: For RQ1, the difficulty is that a creator’s edits are neither pixel perturbations nor free feature vectors. They mix discrete choices, such as which caption, sticker or hashtags to add, with continuous ones, such as position, size and color. The creator sees only a black box. Every upload passes a stochastic codec that rescales, crops and recompresses it. We therefore build REAP, which models edits as programs of a grammar of creator operations, with captions proposed by a language model from the cohort’s popular titles. It scores each program as an average over sampled draws of the platform channel, so that the search favors edits that survive re-encoding, and it searches in two stages, sampling programs and then refining their continuous parameters with CMA-ES. Because a large gain alone does not show that an edit carries the cohort’s meaning, we also run the same search with random words and measure the gain on users outside the target cohort. This decomposition reveals that most of the exposure packaging buys is generic uplift rather than targeted promotion.
blocks.zh: 对 RQ1 来说,困难在于创建者的编辑既不是像素扰动,也不是自由特性向量. 它们混合了独立的选择,如要添加哪些标题、贴纸或标签,并配有连续的选择,如位置、大小和颜色。 创造者只看到一个黑匣子. 每一次上传都会通过一个有花样的可解码器,可以重新调整尺寸,收成并重新压缩. 因此,我们建立了REAP, 它将编辑为创建者操作语法的程序, 它将每个程序评分为平均比被抽取的平台频道平分数,这样搜索偏好会编辑那些在重新编码后幸存下来的程序,它会分两个阶段进行搜索,取样程序,然后用CMA-ES来完善其连续参数. 因为仅凭一个大收益并不能显示编辑会带去组群的意义,所以我们也用随机的单词进行同样的搜索,并衡量目标组群以外的用户的收益. 这一分解表明,大多数接触容器的购买是一般性的提升,而不是有针对性的推广。

blocks.en: For RQ2, a fair test of robust training needs a defense that faces the edits creators can actually make. Norm-ball training does not, since real edits move the claim features far beyond the budgets that keep quality. Training on real edits is not enough either: penalizing any score rise after an edit teaches the tower to punish every edited item, including honest ones, and a tower that ignores all changes no longer rewards better content. We therefore design a strategic training that gives robust training its best chance. It trains on the creator’s best response, picked by the current model from a cached orbit of realizable edits, asks the target audience not to notice that response through a two-sided term, and keeps real content changes rewarded through a margin. Even this defense, like the published UAT-MC [ 33 ] , buys robustness only with recommendation quality: a tower that reads the packaging cannot be made insensitive to it without becoming a worse recommender.
blocks.zh: 对RQ2来说,对强力训练的公平测试需要面对编辑者实际能做的防御. 规范球培训并不如此,因为真正的编辑将索赔内容远远超出保持质量的预算。 对真实编辑的培训也是不够的:在编辑教塔来惩罚每一个被编辑的项目,包括诚实的项目后惩罚任何分数上升,一个无视所有变化的塔不再奖励更好的内容. 因此,我们设计了战略培训,为有力的培训提供最佳机会。 它通过当前模型从可实现编辑的缓存轨道中选择的创造者的最佳反应来训练,要求目标受众不要通过双侧名词注意到该反应,并通过差值来保持真实内容的改变奖励. 即使是这种防御,同已公布的UAT-MC[33]一样,只以推荐质量购买坚固性:一个读取包装的塔,不能使其不敏感而成为更差的推荐者.

blocks.en: For RQ3, we observe that cold-start ranking does not need the packaging: a tower that sees only the video body ranks cold items better than one that also reads covers and titles. Turning this into a deployable ranker raises three challenges. The cold score must come from content the creator cannot change for free. Titles and covers still carry some honest signal, so any use of them needs a guarantee that holds for every edit, not only for the edits an attack tried. Cold and warm items are scored by different models whose scores are not on one scale, yet a user sees one list. We propose Evidence-First Ranking (EFR) to meet them. It splits each upload into the creator’s claims and the evidence of the video body, with text masked out of the frames, and scores cold items from the evidence alone. The claims can only add a residual of norm at most γ \gamma , gated by their support in the body, so no packaging edit can move any score by more than γ \gamma . Cold and warm items are merged by each model’s own rank percentile, which keeps warm rankings intact and carries the γ \gamma bound over to an exact certificate on the merged list that a user sees.
blocks.zh: 对于RQ3,我们观察到冷启动排名不需要包装:一个只看到视频机身的塔对冷物品的排名优于同样阅读封面和标题的塔. 将它变成可部署的军衔,提出了三个挑战。 冷分必须来自创造者不能免费改变的内容。 标题和封面仍然带有一些诚实的信号,所以任何使用它们都需要一个为每次编辑所坚守的保证,而不只是针对尝试攻击的编辑. 冷暖物品被不同的模型打出分数,其分数不在一个尺度上,然而一个用户却看到一个列表. 我们提议首先进行取证。 它将每个上传到创作者的权利主张和录像机构的证据中,将文字蒙住框子,只从证据中评出冷酷物品。 权利主张最多只能增加一个规范的剩余部分,由它们在体内的支持来入门,所以任何包装编辑都无法移动任何分数超过γ\gamma. 冷暖物品由每个模型自己的分数合并, 保持温暖的分数不变,

blocks.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows: • We introduce REAP, a realizable black-box attack that reveals how creator-editable packaging survives platform processing and systematically inflates the exposure of new videos in cold-start recommendation. • We propose Evidence-First Ranking (EFR), an evidence-driven cold-start ranker that bounds the influence of packaging edits and provides an exact per-user certificate. • We conduct extensive experiments on MicroLens-100K across multiple encoders, ranking architectures, and defenses, showing that EFR substantially reduces packaging attacks while preserving recommendation quality.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献概述如下: 我们引入了REAP,一种可实现的黑盒攻击,它揭示出创作-可编辑的包装如何在平台处理中存活下来,并在冷起动推荐中系统地夸大了新视频的曝光. 我们提议采用证据-第一排名(EFR),这是一种由证据驱动的冷启动分级仪,它限制了包装编辑的影响,并提供了准确的每个用户证书。 我们通过多个编码器,排名架构和防御,对MicroLens-100K进行了广泛的实验,显示EFR在保持推荐质量的同时会大幅降低包装攻击.

blocks.en: Attacks on content-aware recommenders. Most attacks on recommenders poison interaction data, injecting fake users whose profiles are optimized to promote a target item [ 29 , 14 , 2 ] , in the extreme with a single fake user [ 12 ] . Personalized models trained across clients are likewise exposed to stealthy backdoors. Cold items have no interactions to poison, so the closer threat for them targets content. Perturbed item images promote items in visually-aware recommenders [ 7 , 18 , 6 ] , and IPDGI [ 3 ] generates such images with guided diffusion. Item text is rewritten against text-aware and LLM-based recommenders [ 23 , 34 , 22 , 39 ] , and VENOMREC [ 9 ] poisons multimodal LLM recommenders across modalities. The encoders behind these towers are themselves steerable: CLIP reads written words as visual concepts [ 20 ] , and small perturbations move multimodal embeddings to arbitrary targets [ 37 ] . These attacks perturb pixels, features or text directly and are rarely measured after a video codec.
blocks.zh: 攻击了解内容的推荐人。 多数攻击推荐者会毒害交互数据,注射假用户的特征被优化,以宣传一个目标项[29,14,2],在极端中与单一假用户[12]. 对客户进行培训的个性化模型同样暴露在隐蔽的后门上。 冷物品没有相互作用来下毒,所以对冷物品的威胁越密切,就会针对内容. 扰动物品图像在视觉感知推荐器[7, 18, 6]中宣传物品,IPDGI[ 3]在引导下生成这种图像. 项目案文根据文本意识和基于LLM的推荐人[23、34、22、39]和VENOMREC[9]对跨模式的多式LLM推荐人进行重写。 这些塔身后面的编码器本身是可操纵的: CLIP将书面词读作视觉概念[20],而小扰动将多式嵌入移动到任意目标[37]. 这些攻击会直接被攻击到像素,特征或文字,很少在视频编码后被测量.

blocks.en: Robust multimodal recommendation. Adversarial training is the main defense. APR [ 11 ] and its successors [ 36 ] perturb user and item embeddings, AMR [ 30 ] perturbs image features, and later work balances modalities, seeks flat minima [ 40 ] or perturbs hidden layers [ 38 ] . UAT-MC [ 33 ] coordinates perturbations across modalities against promotion attacks. Robust CLIP encoders [ 25 ] harden the encoder instead, adversarial hashing hardens cross-modal retrieval [ 24 ] , and adversarial video inputs can be corrected or detected before recognition [ 28 ] . Other defenses down-weight poisoned interactions [ 35 ] , detect backdoored updates in federated training [ 5 , 19 , 4 , 27 ] , or certify robustness to bounded feature or data changes [ 17 , 15 ] . All of them keep reading the packaging, with budgets not tied to realizable edits, and Sec. 3 shows that their robustness costs quality. Cold-start recommenders map content to collaborative embeddings [ 31 , 13 ] but do not separate creator claims from what the video shows.
blocks.zh: 强有力的多式联运建议。 逆行训练是主要防御. APR [11] 及其后继者 [36] 扰动用户和物品嵌入,AMR [30] 扰动图像特性,以及后期工作平衡模式,寻求平面微型 [40] 或扰动隐藏层 [38]. blocks.en: Observation 1: packaging survives the channel and acts mostly as generic uplift. We first measure how much exposure realizable packaging buys after the platform channel (RQ1). REAP raises a cold video by 34.3, 32.0 and 19.3 points on CLIP, SigLIP and hybrid towers ( Table 1 ), and its reach, the share of cohort users with the item in their top 500, grows from 1.5% to 15.2% on SigLIP. A white-box pixel attack falls from 91.5% to 0.6% reach after the channel on SigLIP ( Figure 1 b, 60 targets with 2 cohorts each). The pilot of Figure 1 a renders about 40 edits per target and cohort through a fixed channel draw (CRF 28, 540 pixels, JPEG 70), chooses the best of each family on 500 proxy users and scores it on 1,000 disjoint users. Cover text and title hashtags are the strongest single edits (15 to 20 points on content towers) and combine to about 30, while benign enhancement gains nothing. The random control obtains 25.7 of the 32.0 points on SigLIP, and users outside the target cohorts gain 25.6: the gain comes from searching for any visible edit the tower over-rewards, not from cohort semantics. Without querying the deployed model, an edit selected on a surrogate tower still gains 24.0 points.

REAP在CLIP,SigLIP和混合塔上提升了34.3,32.0和19.3分的冷视频(表1),其覆盖范围是,在SigLIP上,该物品的组群用户比例从1.5%增至15.2%。 在SigLIP上的频道后,白盒像素攻击从91.5%下降到0.6%(图1b,60个目标,每个目标2个组)。 图1 a的试点通过固定通道绘图(CRF 28, 540像素, JPEG 70),对每个家庭的500个代理用户进行最佳选择,对1000个脱节用户进行评分. 封面文字和标题标签是最强的单行编辑(内容塔上为15至20分)并合为约30个,而良性增强则一无所获. 随机控制在SigLIP上获得32.0分中的25.7分,目标组群之外的用户获得25.6分:收益来自搜索任何可见的编辑塔高分,而不是分组语义. 在不查询已部署的模型的情况下,在代号塔上选择的编辑仍然得到24.0分.

blocks.en: Both defenses cut the gain from 29.2 to about 16 points ( Table 2 ), at NDCG@10 changes of -13.8% for strategic training and -13.1% for UAT-MC, yet the 95% intervals of both gains stay above 11 points. AMR at the same budget removes the gain but loses 36% of NDCG@10. Restricting the strategic tower further, so that claims can only re-weight body frames through a capped attention bottleneck, lowers the gain to 13.3 but costs 21% of NDCG@10, and its worst-case bound is vacuous ( Sec. B.5 ). Simpler defenses do not help either ( Sec. B.7 ). Masking text on the cover, attacked on the first 100 targets only ( * in Table 2 ), leaves the gain at 29.6 (33.2 for Cover on the same targets), because titles and hashtags still carry it, and invariance to random edits only lowers it to 23.3, since random edits do not cover the attacker’s best response. As long as the cold item is scored from its packaging, robustness is bought with recommendation quality. The last two columns of Table 2 check that a defense still responds to real content. Body change is the gain toward the matching cohort when half the timeline is replaced by cohort footage, retention divides it by that of Free, and n/a marks towers without body input.
blocks.zh: 这两种防御方法将收益从29.2%削减到大约16分(表2),在NDCG@10中,战略培训的变动为-13.8%,UAT-MC的变动为-13.1%,然而这两种收益的95%的间隔仍然保持在11分以上。 同一预算的AMR取消了收益,但损失了36%的NDCG@10. 进一步限制战略塔,使得索赔只能通过被封住的注意力瓶颈来重新量身定做,将收益降低到13.3,但花费了NDCG@10的21%,而其最坏的束缚是空洞的(Sec. blocks.en: Unseen edits and honest creators. This experiment checks whether strategic training merely memorizes REAP’s grammar and whether defenses harm honest creators ( Table 3 ). With held-out keywords and fonts, strategic training lowers the gain from 18.5 to 10.0 while AMR and UAT-MC remain at the undefended level. However, every tower that reads the packaging also penalizes honest creators: when a creator simply repeats their own title on the cover, the item’s rank drops by 6.7 points under strategic training and by 25–40 points under a one-sided penalty, which effectively learns to punish any edited item. This tests a single honest edit. Honest subtitles, crops and color grading remain untested.
blocks.zh: 不明编辑与诚实创作. 这个实验检查战略训练是否只记住REAP的语法, 有了搁置的关键字和字体,战略培训将收益从18.5降至10.0,而AMR和UAT-MC则保持在未设防的水平上。 然而,每个读取包装的塔也惩罚诚实的创作者:当创作者简单地在封面上重复自己的标题时,物品的军衔在战略训练下会下降6.7分,在片面处罚下会下降25-40分,这实际上可以学会惩罚任何被编辑的项目. 此测试一个诚实的编辑 。 诚实的字幕、作物和颜色分级仍然没有经过测试。

blocks.en: Ablating strategic training. To verify that this baseline is not weakened by a design choice, Table 4 removes one part at a time from seed 0 (seeds span 13.3 to 19.6, so only gaps above six points count). Without the strategic terms the gain returns to the undefended level, so the bottleneck alone is no defense. A one-sided penalty yields negative gains even outside the cohorts, as the tower marks every edited item down. A listwise KL term leaves 9.4 more points than the two-sided term on the bottleneck variant.

blocks.en: Observation 3: cold-start ranking does not need the packaging. Finally, we ask what the packaging contributes to cold-start ranking. In Table 2 , a tower that reads only the body reaches a cold-start Recall@100 of 0.1697, against 0.1133 for the same tower with packaging and at most 0.1485 (AMR) for any defense that keeps reading it. It is a poor warm ranker (NDCG@10 0.0210 against 0.0475), also on warm items with whole-video frames (0.014 against 0.040). The packaging helps warm items and hurts cold ones, which is the asymmetry EFR exploits.
blocks.zh: 观察3:冷启动排名不需要包装. 最后,我们询问包装对冷启动排名有何贡献。 在表2中,一个只读出身体的塔达到冷起重回点@100为0.1697,而同一塔的包装为0.133,任何不断阅读的防御最多为0.1485(AMR)。 它是一种低温分级器(NDCG@10.0.0210对0.0475),同样在全视框(0.014对0.040)的取暖物品上. 包装能帮助取暖物品并伤害冷物品,这就是不对称的EFR开发.

blocks.en: 4.1 Design Challenges and Overview
blocks.zh: 4.1 设计挑战和概览

blocks.en: Section 3 suggests removing the packaging from the cold path rather than training a tower to resist it. Turning this into a ranker that a platform can deploy raises three challenges.
blocks.zh: 第3节建议将包装从冷道上取出,而不是训练起塔来抵抗. 将它变成一个平台可以部署的分级器,提出了三个挑战.

blocks.en: • Challenge I: what should a cold item be scored from? The score must come from content the creator cannot change for free, and it must still rank cold items well. • Challenge II: how much may the packaging count, with a guarantee? Titles and covers carry some honest signal, such as a language or a topic the frames do not show, so ignoring them entirely wastes information. Any use of them, however, must come with a bound that holds for every edit, not only for the edits an attack tried. • Challenge III: how do cold and warm items share one list? A user sees one list, while cold and warm items are scored by different models whose scores are not on one scale. The merge must keep warm quality and must not void the guarantee of Challenge II.
blocks.zh: • 挑战一:冷货应该从哪得分? 得分必须来自创作者不能免费改变的内容,它仍然必须很好地排列出冷酷物品. • 挑战二:有保证的包装可以计算多少? 标题和封面带有一些诚实的信号,例如一个语言或一个框架没有显示的主题,因此完全忽略了它们浪费的信息. 然而,任何使用它们的行为都必须带有一个约束,它不仅适用于尝试攻击的编辑,而且适用于每次编辑。 • 挑战三:冷热物品如何共享一个清单? 一个用户看到一个列表,而冷热物品则被不同的模型打出分数不在一个尺度上. 合并必须保有保温质量,不得取消挑战二的保证.

blocks.en: Overview. Figure 2 illustrates how EFR addresses the three design challenges while preserving the platform’s existing warm-item ranker. A creator first uploads a video together with its packaging. In the example shown, a real REAP edit of a cold cooking video targeting the Game cohort adds a caption and three hashtags, increasing its rank by 43 percentile points on the undefended tower. After the platform channel re-encodes the upload, ① EFR splits the creator’s claims from the evidence in the video body (Challenge I, Sec. 4.2 ). ② A cold tower embeds the evidence into a unit vector and computes the cold score solely from the video body (Challenge I, Sec. 4.3 ). ③ The claims can influence the score only through a support-gated residual with norm at most γ \gamma , which bounds the effect of any packaging edit (Challenge II, Sec. 4.4 ). ④ Cold and warm items are merged using each model’s own rank percentile, preserving warm-item rankings and carrying the γ \gamma bound to the final recommendation list, yielding an exact certificate on the effect of arbitrary packaging edits (Challenge III, Sec. 4.5 ).

blocks.en: 4.5 Rank-Calibrated Merging and Certificate
blocks.zh: 4.5 分级合并和证书

blocks.en: Scores of the two models are not on the same scale, so EFR merges rankings rather than raw scores. The warm-item ranker and the cold tower each rank the entire catalogue independently for a given user. A warm item enters the final list according to its rank percentile under the warm ranker, whereas a cold item enters according to its rank percentile under the cold tower. The final list merges these percentiles. Both percentiles are uniform over the catalogue, so neither model fills the top of the list only because its scores run larger. This procedure preserves the relative ordering of warm items. Moreover, because the merging rule is monotonic with respect to the cold-item score, the guarantee of Proposition 1 carries over to the final ranking.

blocks.en: Robustness and utility. The main experiment asks whether EFR removes the attack gain without the quality cost of Sec. 3 . Table 5 shows that it does. At γ = 0.02 \gamma=0.02 , REAP gains only 5.4 points (81% less than on Free), and the upper end of its 95% interval, 5.9, lies far below the lower end of 27.6 for Free. Reach grows from 3.3% to 5.0% instead of from 1.6% to 12.8%. Against Free, 69% of the 900 target-cohort pairs gain more than 20 points, while no pair gains more than 12 points against EFR at γ = 0.02 \gamma=0.02 ( Figure 5 ). Cold-start Recall@100 rises to 0.170, above every tower that reads the packaging (at most 0.1485 in Table 2 ), and the merged NDCG@10 stays within 4% of the undefended system (0.0451 against 0.0469), because warm items keep their ranker. The rank-calibrated merge matters: merging by per-user standardized scores instead fills 46% of the top 10 with cold items and loses 34% of NDCG@10. A small packaging budget also helps honest creators, since γ = 0.02 \gamma=0.02 and 0.05 0.05 beat the body-only router on cold recall. Overall, EFR uniquely balances utility, robustness, and certified resistance to cold-start attacks, without sacrificing the quality of all its recommendations.

blocks.en: Certification and the choice of γ \gamma . We next test how tight the guarantee is and how γ \gamma trades exposure for utility. The certificate holds for every packaging edit, not only those REAP tried, and it stays close to the attack. At γ = 0.02 \gamma=0.02 it bounds the gain at 7.5 points, 1.4 × \times the strongest attack we found, with 31% of pairs certified below 5 points, and across γ \gamma the ratio stays between 1.4 and 1.7. blocks.en: 6 Discussion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 6. 讨论和限制

blocks.en:
EFR rests on the observation that the body of a cold video ranks better than its packaging. This held on both encoders and with content and hybrid warm rankers, but it is a property of the data: where bodies are uninformative, such as static slideshows, a platform would choose a larger γ \gamma , and Proposition 1 states the worst-case exposure this buys. The certificate covers edits of the packaging with the body fixed, and it is per user, so a single cover and title shared by all users stays below it. The same per-user slack is one reason why the bound of the attention bottleneck stays far above the attack, and that bound also relaxes the attention set beyond what fixed keys and unit queries can reach (Remark 1 ).
Our study has limits. No humans annotated edits, so realizability rests on construction. There is no second-stage ranker. REAP queries exact proxy scores, which favors the attacker. Evidence is frames only. Ablations use a single seed per variant. Cohorts are tag-based and the data come from one platform, with comments standing in as a proxy for the exposure of a video. Extending the evidence to audio and speech is left to future work.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
This paper revisits packaging attacks in short-video recommendation. We show that creator-realizable edits to covers, titles, and hashtags remain effective after platform processing, while existing adversarial-training defenses struggle to achieve both robustness and recommendation quality.
To address this issue, we propose Evidence-First Ranking (EFR), which explicitly separates creator claims from video evidence, ranks cold items primarily according to the video body, and strictly bounds the influence of packaging. This design preserves recommendation quality while providing a provable guarantee against arbitrary packaging edits.
Our findings suggest that the key challenge in cold-start recommendation is not learning to resist packaging, but avoiding reliance on packaging when allocating exposure.
blocks.zh:
本文在短视频推荐中重温了包装攻击. 我们显示,在平台处理后,可覆盖、标题和标签的可创建-可实现编辑仍然有效,而现有的对抗训练防御则在努力实现强健性和推荐质量。
为了解决这一问题,我们提出证据-第一排名(EFR),明确将创作者的权利主张与视频证据区分开来,主要根据视频体对冷物品进行排名,并严格限定包装的影响. 这种设计保持了推荐质量,同时提供了防止任意包装编辑的可证明的保证.
我们的调查结果表明,冷启动建议的关键挑战不是学会抵制包装,而是在分配接触时避免依赖包装。

blocks.en: Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: All experiments are offline, on public data under its academic license, and never touch a live platform. MicroLens videos are not redistributed. Edited covers stay on the lab server, and the paper shows one cover, taken from a cooking video with no people. We release the edit grammar, the attack and defense code and aggregate numbers. The attack describes edits that creators already make by hand, and its main finding points to a defense that platforms can deploy cheaply. We believe that the defensive value of this work outweighs the small help it gives to an attacker.

blocks.en: Why not a listwise KL? A natural alternative matches the softmax of cohort scores before and after the edit. This distribution is invariant to adding a constant to every user’s score, and a constant rise across the cohort is exactly what lifts an item in everyone’s ranking, so the KL term cannot see the dominant effect of gaming. In our ablation it leaves more gain than the two-sided term on both of the architectures we test ( Sec. 3.2 ).
blocks.zh: 为什么没有列表 KL ? 编辑前后组分的软度大小 。 这种分布对每个用户的分数都无常地增加一个常数,整个组别不断上升正是举起每个人排名中的项目的原因,因此KL一词无法看出游戏的主导效果. 在我们的衰落中,它为我们测试的两种建筑都留下了比双面术语更多的收益(第3.2节)。

blocks.en: Why not a one-sided penalty? Penalizing only a rise, ( ⋅ ) + (\cdot)_{+} instead of | ⋅ | |\cdot| , looks like the natural objective. The tower can meet it by learning an edit detector , which lowers the score whenever the cover or title looks edited. Such a model reports a negative attack gain, which reads as a perfect defense but only means that edits are punished. The two-sided term removes this escape: it asks the tower to ignore the edit, not to punish it. Section 3.2 measures the one-sided variant on attacks and on honest edits. On development items, an honest creator who repeats words of their own title on the cover loses 39.6 rank-percentile points among real commenters under the one-sided variant of Strategic training, against 6.7 under the two-sided term of Eq. 9 on the same development items ( Table 3 ).

blocks.en: For each target, cohort and evaluation user we compute the certified rank of Corollary 2 . Figure 3 in the main text summarizes all 25 settings. On CLIP the selected setting certifies 48 to 49 points across seeds, and the certified top-500 reach stays above 99.9%. Lowering γ \gamma mainly lowers the certified reach, from above 99% to 21%, while the certified mean gain never falls below 36.9. The looseness is structural ( Remark 1 ): the bound lets every user face a different worst-case claim, while a creator publishes one, and it relaxes the attention set beyond what fixed keys and unit queries can actually reach.

blocks.en: What the attacker uses. Figure 7 counts the operations in the programs that REAP selects against Free and against EFR at γ = 0.02 \gamma=0.02 , with 900 programs each over 3 seeds. Captions and hashtags appear in more than 90% of them, while stickers, recoloring and crops appear in 21% to 42%. Against EFR the mix barely changes (captions 97% against 94%), so EFR does not push the attacker toward other operations. Stickers even become rarer, falling from 42% to 35% of the programs, and recoloring falls from 32% to 28%. Hashtags drop slightly as well, from 92% to 90%. EFR bounds the effect of every operation.
blocks.zh: 攻击者使用的东西. 图7统计REAP针对Free和EFR选择的方案中的操作,在γ = 0.02\gamma= 0.02时,每个有900个方案在3个种子上. 说明和标签出现在90%以上,而标签、再彩色和作物则出现在21%至42%。 因此EFR并没有将攻击者推向其他行动。 贴纸甚至变得稀有,从42%的节目降至35%,再彩色从32%降至28%. Hashtags也略有下降,从92%下降到90%. EFR限制了每次行动的效果.
